description: This is a C# source file containing unit tests for Orleans serialization, specifically testing version tolerance features. It includes test classes, serializers, and data type definitions relevant to serialization behavior across different object versions.

classes.name: ManualVersionToleranceTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans serialization version tolerance features, including round-trip serialization and deserialization, handling of new and old object versions, and reference tracking.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewField
classes.description: Data class with an additional field 'NewField' to test schema evolution during serialization.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer for ObjectWithNewField, intentionally not serializing the 'NewField' to simulate backward compatibility.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewField
classes.description: Data class representing an older version without the 'NewField', used to test deserialization of newer objects.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer for ObjectWithoutNewField, serializing all fields except the 'NewField'.

classes.name: BaseType
classes.description: Base class with string properties, with hand-rolled serializer to test inheritance support in serialization.

classes.name: SubType
classes.description: Derived class extending BaseType, with additional properties, and custom serializer implementing field reading/writing.

classes.name: SubTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for SubType, handles custom field serialization and deserialization, respecting versioning.

classes.name: BaseTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for BaseType, handles serialization of base class properties.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer that ignores 'NewField' to simulate older version serialization.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer that serializes a future 'NewField' that might not be deserialized by older serializers.

methods.name: VersionTolerance_RoundTrip_Tests
methods.description: Main test method executing multiple round-trip serialization tests for SubType instances.

methods.name: RoundTripTest
methods.description: Helper method to perform serialization/deserialization round-trip and validate object equivalence.

methods.name: TestSkip
methods.description: Tests skipping of unknown fields during deserialization to maintain version tolerance.

methods.name: GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a new serialization session from the session pool.

methods.name: GetGeneratedSerializer
methods.description: Utility to obtain a generated serializer instance for a specific type.
